heading: ### The six-leg regression — usage and this round's receipt

findings.quote: - F1: “The runbook's §7 is the operator's rendering of this command” — this is false at CAND1: the section says regression executes the command but describes only four legs and says cases 5/6 are not embedded (`corpus/knowledge/operator-runbook.md:345-376`), while the CAND1 tool embeds ten legs (`tools/mutate-and-run.sh:88-97,1459-1507`). Command: `git -C /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin show 7ff81a5b0ab0fbaefd68cf4ef9dcfe687a6d7135:corpus/knowledge/operator-runbook.md | nl -ba | sed -n '345,376p'; git -C /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin show 7ff81a5b0ab0fbaefd68cf4ef9dcfe687a6d7135:tools/mutate-and-run.sh | nl -ba | sed -n '88,97p;1459,1507p'`.
